title: Stock Market Today Live, Oct 6: Stock to buy today: Aditya Infotech (₹3,989.05) - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates - Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 6 October 2026

Jane Street has denied market manipulation charges and sought additional information from SEBI on the investigation and earlier internal reviews.

Narayana Hrudayalaya has agreed to operate and manage Mission of Mercy Hospital in Kolkata, a 100-bed facility with a built-up area of 63,240.37 sq ft.

Elon Musk’s fortune jumped $65 billion to $1.04 trillion as SpaceX shares rose 13% and Tesla gained 6.7% since the start of October.

Markets may be shifting from easy-money to a new regime, demanding vigilance as valuations adjust and old paradigms reset.

Aurobindo’s near-term growth driven by US/Lannett, Europe, and Pen-G, with long-term upside from biologics/biosimilars and margin-led expansion.

Maharashtra Charity Commissioner seeks Tata Trusts’ response by October 12 to complaints filed by trustees Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh.

Bhavya Rasayan scheme will establish three chemical parks, with Centre providing Rs 1,000 crore and states contributing a minimum of Rs 500 crore each.

Zydus Lifesciences and MSN Laboratories launch the first generic Riociguat tablets in the US across five strengths after USFDA approval.

Buy natural gas futures: potential rally from ₹293 with key support at ₹280, targeting ₹310–₹325; risk-managed trade plan included.

Bullish short-term outlook for Aditya Infotech with near-term targets to ₹4,200–₹4,220 and actionable buy/stop-loss guidance.
